meta.name: Process RFQ quotes from Gmail PDFs using Claude, PostgreSQL, and Slack

name: Engineering RFQ Processing with PDF Extraction and Automated Quote Generation

parameters.content:
## Untitled workflow

### How it works

1. The workflow triggers upon receiving an incoming RFQ email and loads initial configuration settings.
2. It extracts and validates product specifications from PDF attachments using Claude Vision, handling low confidence via manual review requests.
3. It normalizes specifications, computes complexity and material utilization scores, and enriches data with supplier capabilities and historical pricing from PostgreSQL.
4. It scores supplier matches, estimates costs with Claude, aggregates metrics, and generates a comparison matrix and final PDF quote sent via Gmail.
5. Finally, it routes by complexity, notifies the engineering team via Slack, and logs overall processing data and supplier performance in PostgreSQL.

### Setup steps

- - [ ] Connect Gmail account for triggering RFQ emails and sending final quotes.
- - [ ] Configure Anthropic (Claude) credentials for vision extraction, cost estimation, and quote writing.
- - [ ] Set up PostgreSQL database connections for querying supplier capabilities, historical pricing, and logging performance.
- - [ ] Configure Slack bot credentials for sending manual review alerts and engineering notifications.

### Customization

You can customize the confidence threshold for manual reviews and adjust the supplier scoring weights to match your specific business priorities.

## Trigger and configuration

Triggers workflow upon receiving an RFQ email and loads initial configuration settings.

## Extract specs with Claude Vision

Checks for PDF attachments in the email and uses Claude Vision to extract raw product specifications.

## Validate extraction and confidence

Validates extraction quality and checks confidence scores, requesting manual review via Slack if confidence is low.

## Normalize specs and compute metrics

Normalizes specs to standards and calculates complexity scores and material utilization metrics.

## Query and enrich supplier data

Queries supplier capabilities and historical pricing data from PostgreSQL, then merges the enrichment data.

## Score suppliers and estimate costs

Scores supplier matches and estimates costs using Claude AI to evaluate potential options.

## Aggregate quotes and generate matrix

Aggregates quote metrics and generates a comprehensive comparison matrix across suppliers.

## Create quote and email customer

Writes the final quote using Claude, generates a PDF quote, and sends it via Gmail to the customer.

## Route complexity and notify engineering

Routes workflow based on complexity and prepares/sends Slack notifications to the engineering team.

## Log processing and supplier performance

Logs RFQ processing details, updates supplier capacity, and logs final supplier performance in PostgreSQL.

values.content:
Analyze the PDF technical drawing and extract the following information:

1. Material specification
2. Dimensions
3. Tolerances
4. Surface finish requirements
5. Quantity
6. Delivery requirements

Provide the extracted information in a structured format.

parameters.query: SELECT supplier_id, supplier_name, material_capabilities, max_tolerance_grade, current_capacity_percent, avg_lead_time_days, quality_score FROM suppliers WHERE material_capabilities LIKE '%' || {{ $json.materialCode }} || '%' AND max_tolerance_grade >= {{ $json.toleranceGrade }} ORDER BY quality_score DESC LIMIT 10

options.system: You are a manufacturing cost estimation expert. Based on the technical specifications and supplier capabilities provided, estimate the cost breakdown for each of the top 3 suppliers. Include: material cost (based on material type, dimensions, and quantity), machining time estimate (hours), labor cost, overhead allocation, and recommended margin. Provide three pricing options: competitive (low margin), standard (normal margin), and premium (high margin/fast delivery). Return your response in JSON format for structured cost estimates.

values.content: =You are a professional quote writer for an engineering manufacturing company. Generate a comprehensive, professional quote document based on the RFQ specifications and cost estimates provided. Include: 1) Technical specifications summary (material, dimensions, tolerances, surface finish, quantity), 2) Three pricing options with breakdown (competitive/standard/premium), 3) Lead time for each option, 4) Terms and conditions, 5) Validity period (30 days), 6) Professional formatting with clear sections. Make it ready to send to the customer. Input: {{ $json }}

parameters.message: Please find attached our quote for your RFQ. We have provided three pricing options for your consideration. The quote is valid for 30 days. Please let us know if you have any questions.
parameters.subject: =Quote for RFQ - {{ $('Normalize Specifications').item.json.materialCode }}

parameters.query: SELECT material_code, avg_price_per_kg, price_trend_30d, last_quote_date, avg_lead_time FROM historical_pricing WHERE material_code = '{{ $('Normalize Specifications').item.json.materialCode }}' ORDER BY last_quote_date DESC LIMIT 10
